name: First Advantage
summary: First Advantage is a large screening provider that now also serves former Sterling customers. It publishes no prices, so buyers request a quote. It covers county, federal and international criminal searches, says it has more than 100 ATS and HCM integrations, and documents the FCRA disclosure and authorization steps for clients.

facts.text: First Advantage says county court record searches are available in over 3,100 US counties.
The Sterling website now says Sterling is part of First Advantage and sends new customers to First Advantage sales.
The integrations page cites 100+ integration options including Workday, iCIMS and Bullhorn, and names 18 partners in all.
First Advantage's FCRA page says the disclosure must be in a separate document and that the employer must obtain written authorization from the applicant.
Candidates enter their information in a portal called Profile Advantage, and the same page does not describe consent wording.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: No prices are published. Buyers contact sales
